type Up = Uppercase<`x${number}`>;
const a: Up = 'x1';
const b: Up = 'X1e5';
type Low = Lowercase<`X${number}`>;
const c: Low = 'X1';
const d: Low = 'x1E5';
type Cap = Capitalize<`item-${string}`>;
const e: Cap = 'item-any';
type CapLead = Capitalize<`${string}-end`>;
const f: CapLead = 'abc-end';
type Unc = Uncapitalize<`Key${number}`>;
const g: Unc = 'Key1';
type UpBig = Uppercase<`id${bigint}`>;
const h: UpBig = 'ID0xff';
type Nested = Uppercase<`a${Lowercase<string>}`>;
const i: Nested = 'Ab';
const up: Uppercase<`${number}px`> = '10px';
console.log(a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, up);
